newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 3 (Reuder) - Trade was quiet, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market
Confirmed - 300 last week - 7,000 last year - holiday

Inquiry moderate, demand light. Sales confirmed on 300 cattle, mostly heifers. This week's confirmed sales 76,600 head including 20,800 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter heifers - pen Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 62.00; pen mixed slaughter steers and heifers Commercial to Choice with end heiferettes 1125 lbs 61.00.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
